reference: Independent Python re-derivation (onref.py) of ISO 9613-1:1993 clause 6 and CNOSSOS-EU (Directive (EU) 2015/996) Annex II section 2.5.6. No value is copied from the tool or from the shipped artifact.
reference_citations: ISO 9613-1:1993, Acoustics -- Attenuation of sound during propagation outdoors -- Part 1: Calculation of the absorption of sound by the atmosphere, clause 6, eq. (3), (4), (5).
ISO 9613-2:1996, Part 2: General method of calculation, Table 2 -- published atmospheric attenuation coefficients, used as an independent cross-check of the ISO 9613-1 implementation.

Commission Directive (EU) 2015/996 of 19 May 2015 establishing common noise assessment methods (CNOSSOS-EU) pursuant to Directive 2002/49/EC, Annex II section 2.5.6, eq. 2.5.11-2.5.22 (A_div, A_atm, A_ground under homogeneous and favourable conditions, G'_path, w, C_f, Delta_dif, C'', the least-squares mean ground plane and the long-term combination).

Commission Delegated Directive (EU) 2021/1226 of 21 December 2020, Annex, amending Annex II of Directive 2002/49/EC (diffraction eligibility, multiple diffraction, favourable curved rays, ground corrections).
provenance_note: Every one of the 230 reference values, and all 7 extras, was re-derived in Python from ISO 9613-1:1993 clause 6 and CNOSSOS-EU (Directive (EU) 2015/996) Annex II 2.5.6 by /root/bench3/onref.py, which reads no tool source and copies no stored value; the atmospheric term is additionally cross-checked against the published table ISO 9613-2:1996 Table 2. The shipped artifact's recorded numbers were used only to recover the case inputs it failed to record, never as a reference.

published_table.source: Octave-band atmospheric attenuation coefficients printed in an earlier edition of ISO 9613-2 Table 2, reproduced in EMD International, "The International rule DIN ISO 9613-2", windPRO DECIBEL Appendix A (https://help.emd.dk/knowledgebase/content/windPRO4.1/Appendix_A_DECIBEL.pdf).
published_table.verdict: reproduced to the table's own printed resolution

crosscheck.note: Only the CNOSSOS ground, diffraction, mean-plane, arc and assembly terms have no second implementation available here; they rest on the standard text alone.

tolerance: Attenuation terms and assembled levels: absolute <= 0.002 dB (0.002 dB/km for alpha); assembled propagation levels <= 0.003 dB; G' <= 1e-10; mean-plane slope/intercept <= 2e-5; favourable-arc geometry <= 2e-8 m; image-source geometry <= 1e-10 m. Identical to the tolerances the shipped artifact declared; none was widened.

instrumentation.method: Playwright route on outdoornoise.html; the served body is fetched from the real server and ONE read-only block is appended immediately before the IIFE's closing })();
instrumentation.served_md5_equals_disk_file: md5 of the intercepted body is the md5 of /root/refactored3/outdoornoise.html on disk -- the runner drove the shipped bytes
instrumentation.reason: The tool publishes no globals; none of the 230 graded quantities is reachable from the page's public surface.

worker_agreement.note: Map cells are solved in the Worker built by workerPreamble(); each sampled cell is re-solved on the main thread through the tool's own solveReceiver and differenced. Tolerance 1e-9 dB(A). This is a consistency check between two copies of the same source, not an independent reference.

dom_surface.note: The path inspector #pathBody is the only public surface that prints these equation terms. It prints Adiv/Aatm/A_bound/L_H/L_F/L_LT at 1 decimal and Aground/DeltaDif/Adif at 2 in the cell tooltip, so on its own it can support +/-0.05 dB and +/-0.005 dB, not the 0.002 dB this benchmark grades at. Checked here only to prove the instrumented calls and the visible page are one computation.

scene_smoke.note: Every map cell of every built-in preset checked finite. Not a reference check.

drift_vs_shipped_artifact.note: Values recorded as `got` by the 2026-08-14 run of the artifact, compared with what the shipping build produces now for the same case and key.
drift_vs_shipped_artifact.analysis: Every movement is at the last few ulps and every one is inside tolerance. 61 of them are the atmosphere group and are explained exactly: the 2026-08-14 harness evaluated atmosphereAlpha at the exact ISO band centres 10**(n/10), while the tool's own ATM_BANDS are those centres rounded to 12 significant digits. Recomputing case atmosphere-016 at Math.pow(10,3.9) reproduces the artifact's recorded 116.88204449160101 to the last digit, and at the tool's literal 7943.282347243 gives 116.88204449160594, which is what this run produced. The remaining 5 are last-ulp differences in the assembly group. No number in this benchmark moved materially between the 2026-08-14 build and the shipping build.

not_benchmarked.Scene topology: Lateral path-finding, reflector eligibility, retro-diffraction, second-order reflection topology and mixed reflection-diffraction topology are not graded against any reference; only checked finite over the 17 built-in presets.
not_benchmarked.Terrain/GIS: TIN triangulation and interpolation are not graded against an external GIS implementation. The least-squares mean plane itself is graded.
not_benchmarked.ISO/TR 17534-4 TCxx scenes: Not executed. The reference tables are not public.
not_benchmarked.Measured validation: None. No field measurement and no third-party review is claimed.
not_benchmarked.Reachability: The graded quantities are reached by instrumenting the shipped source, not through any user-visible control of the page.
